A '''trade officer''' was a kind of functionary working for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Gode Takrab]] was a trade officer.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The original source alternatively uses "trade officer" and "Trade Officer".

As Takrab's superior is [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], Trade officers can be assumed to be subordinate to [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officers]].
